# teams agent user create

Create an Agent 365 agentic user (and its identity + blueprint if needed)

## Usage

```
teams agent user create [blueprintId] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `blueprintId` | [OPTIONAL] Existing agent blueprint ID to reuse. Creates a new blueprint if omitted. | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--blueprint-name <name>` | [OPTIONAL] Name for a newly created blueprint. Not valid together with [blueprintId]. |
| `--user-name <name>` | [OPTIONAL] Display name for the agentic user. Defaults to the blueprint's name. |
| `--endpoint <url>` | [OPTIONAL] HTTPS messaging endpoint to register on a newly created blueprint. Not valid together with [blueprintId]. |
| `--license <skuId>` | [OPTIONAL] License SKU ID or part number to assign to the agentic user. Falls back to `teams config` default-license when omitted. |
| `--no-license` | [OPTIONAL] Skip license assignment (do it manually later) |
| `--usage-location <code>` | [OPTIONAL] Two-letter country code for the agentic user’s usage location (e.g. US). Falls back to `teams config` default-usage-location when omitted. |
| `--env <path>` | [OPTIONAL] Path to credentials file (.env or C# appsettings.json) |
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Credential destination

Uses the same C# project detection and credential destination selection as
`teams app create`. Pass `--env <path>` to choose a file explicitly, including
a nested `MyAgent/appsettings.Development.json` for C# projects. C# appsettings
files receive the `AzureAd` configuration expected by the agent runtime.

The root `.env` is always retained for blueprint credential reuse. When the local
config and `.env` match the blueprint, their existing client secret is reused and
copied to the selected destination rather than generating another secret.
JSON mode does not prompt or select an additional destination without `--env`.
